lines.text: Never answer a stranger who knows your name.
Every morning at 7:40, a man waits at Stop 14.
lines.say: Every morning at seven forty, a man waits at Stop fourteen.

lines.text: Gray coat. Never gets on. Just watches me.
Today he said: Morning, Sam. Late again.
I never told him my name.
Then a bus pulled up. One I'd never seen.
He grabbed my arm: Not this one.
The doors closed. It left without me.
Its sign said: Not in service. Since 1986.
lines.say: Its sign said: Not in service. Since nineteen eighty-six.

lines.text: Then I saw the scar on his chin.
My scar. My eyes. Forty years older.
I got on that bus, he said. I never got off.
So if a stranger knows your name, don't answer.
